import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Price distribution by sensor type (boxplot)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', ax=axes[0, 0], palette='viridis')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Camera Price Distribution by Sensor Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
axes[0, 0].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Megapixels vs Price colored by body type (scatter plot)
scatter = axes[0, 1].scatter(df['megapixels'], df['price_usd'], 
                             c=df['weight_grams'], cmap='plasma', 
                             alpha=0.7, s=50, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Megapixels vs Price (colored by weight)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 1])
cbar.set_label('Weight (grams)', fontsize=12)

# 3. Camera count by brand (top 10 brands)
top_brands = df['brand'].value_counts().head(10)
bars = axes[1, 0].bar(top_brands.index, top_brands.values, color=sns.color_palette('husl', 10))
axes[1, 0].set_title('Top 10 Camera Brands by Count', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Brand', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Number of Cameras', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Add value labels on bars
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[1, 0].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.5,
                   f'{int(height)}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 4. Average price by body type and 4K video capability
price_by_body_video = df.groupby(['body_type', 'has_video_4k'])['price_usd'].mean().unstack()
price_by_body_video.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[1, 1], color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'])
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Price by Body Type and 4K Video Capability', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].legend(['No 4K Video', 'Has 4K Video'], title='4K Video')
axes[1, 1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
